recipients.body: This message concerns your position on ETX-NTX Segment SEG-2 for gas day 2026-08-04. Scheduled quantity: 250,000 Dth. Projected quantity (run-rate extrapolation over 6 measured hours): 287,500 Dth. Imbalance: +37,500 Dth (+15.0%). Stage 2 tolerance: 5% (12,500 Dth). Excess over tolerance: 25,000 Dth. Exposure formula: 25,000 Dth x $25.00/Dth x 1 day = $625,000.00 (GT&C §52.3 synthetic). The current open cycle is ID3, deadline 2026-08-04 19:00 CT. Your contract CTR-LSPP-FT1 shows storage rights of 40,000 Dth at RP-BETH, which is downstream of SEG-2; you may wish to consider whether your storage rights offer a cure path, alongside any other contract-backed options available to you, ahead of the deadline. This is informational; the decision on how to manage your position is yours.

latestNotice.headline: Proposed Operational Flow Order — SEG-2 Stage 2 Constraint
latestNotice.body_text: This is a proposed Operational Flow Order (OFO) for ETX-NTX Segment SEG-2 (Midland Junction to Abilene Junction), effective upon posting. Cause: SEG-2 is scheduled at its derated operating capacity with zero available transportation capacity (820,000 Dth scheduled against 820,000 Dth operating capacity), and projected run-day imbalances indicate uncured over-take risk on the segment. Derated capacity: 820,000 Dth. Stage: Stage 2. Tolerance: 5% of scheduled quantity (GT&C §52.3 synthetic). Imbalance basis: projected gas-day total (run-rate extrapolation) versus scheduled quantity. Synthetic tariff rate: $25.00/Dth (2,500 cents/Dth) on imbalance in excess of tolerance (GT&C §52.3 synthetic). This is projected potential exposure, not an assessed penalty or commodity market price. Actionable cycle: ID3, deadline 2026-08-04 19:00 CT. Shippers with projected imbalances exceeding the Stage 2 tolerance on SEG-2 should review corrective options ahead of this deadline to manage potential exposure under GT&C §52.3 (synthetic).
